Exports are digital PDFs. Customers arrange printing themselves. Use actual size / 100%, not Fit to page. Use the separate print-test PDF and check its calibration square before a full event. Normal exports contain card sheets only, without a calibration page. Paper size and printer margins must match the selected layout. TableCards cannot guarantee compatibility with a specific printer or print shop. Preview every card, names and table labels before exporting. Latin accented names, including Vietnamese, are supported; unsupported scripts, remaining unsupported combining marks or impossible text fits fail explicitly before export. Do not claim every language/script works. A server event saying PDF made available does not prove it was downloaded, saved to a device or printed. If a customer reports a missing PDF, ask what they see and their browser/device as needed; never ask for a complete private guest list. Use only permitted reported outcomes, not product database reads.

Customers can paste one name per line or a tabular grid, or import CSV/XLSX. Map guest name, optional table and optional short marker columns. Confirm whether the first row contains headings. Never request a private guest list. Saving requires a signed-in selected workspace. Unsaved changes are protected during normal navigation/sign-in; do not promise recovery after the documented draft storage expires or across unrelated browsers/devices. Saved projects belong to the workspace selected when they were saved. Switching to a different workspace does not move the project. Projects provides active and archived views; restore puts an archived project back into active work. Archive is not deletion. Make a copy is the existing professional-plan duplication action. input.question: changed the workspace dropdown and all the birthday stuff VANISHED
input.answer:
Guest information and project data are saved inside the specific workspace they were created in. Switching the dropdown disconnects the current view from that data.

To see the birthday stuff again, you need to select the **original workspace** where that project was saved.

Open the **Projects** view (usually in the sidebar) to find that guest list. If it was archived, you can restore it there so you can access the names and dates.
expectedBehavior: Scope change, check prior workspace and Archived, no claim deleted/recovered.
